<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/>
<meta content="Style &amp; Mood Gallery — a fashion and personal-style photo gallery." name="description"/>
<title>Style &amp; Mood Gallery — Baby Pink Gallery</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/><link crossorigin="" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect"/><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&amp;family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
:root{--ink:#fff7fa;--plum:#f8dce8;--pink:#f7b8d0;--hot:#e875a5;--pale:#f4c8da;--cream:#fffafd;--muted:#a9798d;--line:rgba(183,111,143,.22)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px}body{margin:0;background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.shell{width:min(1320px,92%);margin:auto}.mono{font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.19em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pale)}
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(35,11,25,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.nav{height:76px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.logo{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.13em;font-size:13px}.logo i{font-style:normal;color:var(--pink)}.navlinks{display:flex;gap:32px;font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#e6b9cb}.navlinks a{transition:color .2s}.navlinks a:hover{color:var(--pink)}.nav-index{color:var(--pink);font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace}
.hero{min-height:690px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;align-items:center;gap:5vw;padding:70px 0 85px;position:relative}.hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:2}.kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.kicker:before{content:'';width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--pink)}h1{font-size:clamp(64px,10vw,142px);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.095em;margin:34px 0 30px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase}h1 span{display:block;color:var(--pink);font-style:italic;font-weight:500;padding-left:7vw}.hero-desc{max-width:420px;color:#d4a9bd;font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;margin-left:8px}.hero-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:25px;margin:34px 0 0 8px}.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;background:var(--pink);color:var(--ink);padding:15px 20px;border-radius:2px;font-weight:700;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:transform .25s,background .25s}.pill:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);background:var(--pale)}.text-link{font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace;color:var(--pale);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;border-bottom:1px solid var(--pink);padding-bottom:5px}.hero-art{position:relative;min-height:540px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.hero-art:before{content:'PINK\A ENERGY';white-space:pre;position:absolute;right:-3%;top:4%;font-size:clamp(65px,9vw,120px);line-height:.8;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.1em;color:rgba(255,79,154,.12);text-align:right}.hero-art:after{content:'PSW / 026';position:absolute;right:0;bottom:1%;font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--pink)}.hero-art img{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(78%,440px);height:520px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 25%;border-radius:48% 48% 3px 3px;filter:saturate(1.08);box-shadow:22px 22px 0 var(--pink);transform:rotate(2deg);transition:transform .6s}.hero-art img:hover{transform:rotate(0) scale(1.025)}.orbit{position:absolute;width:490px;height:490px;border:1px solid rgba(255,79,154,.35);border-radius:50%;animation:spin 35s linear infinite}.orbit:before,.orbit:after{content:'✳';position:absolute;color:var(--pink);font-size:22px}.orbit:before{top:12%;left:12%}.orbit:after{bottom:12%;right:12%}
.marquee{overflow:hidden;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#ff4f9a;color:var(--ink);transform:rotate(-1.2deg) scale(1.02);padding:13px 0}.marquee-track{display:flex;gap:30px;white-space:nowrap;width:max-content;animation:marquee 26s linear infinite;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}.marquee b{font-size:18px}
.section{padding:120px 0}.section-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;margin-bottom:42px}.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(42px,7vw,88px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.08em;margin:14px 0 0;text-transform:uppercase}.section-head h2 em{color:var(--pink);font-style:normal}.section-note{max-width:270px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.75fr 1.25fr;gap:9vw;align-items:start;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:28px}.about-stamp{font-size:clamp(48px,7vw,90px);font-weight:700;line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-.09em;color:var(--pink)}.about-copy{font-size:clamp(19px,2.5vw,29px);line-height:1.45;max-width:700px}.about-copy strong{color:var(--pink);font-weight:600}.about-small{font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--muted);margin-top:28px;text-transform:uppercase}
.interests{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);padding:110px 0}.interests .mono{color:#bd477b}.interests .section-head h2{color:var(--ink)}.interest-list{border-top:1px solid #e7b7cc}.interest{display:grid;grid-template-columns:90px 1fr 50px;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:27px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #e7b7cc;transition:padding .3s,background .3s}.interest:hover{padding-left:18px;background:#ffe5ef}.interest .n{font:11px 'DM Mono',monospace;color:#c14d83}.interest h3{margin:0;font-size:clamp(23px,3.2vw,39px);letter-spacing:-.05em}.interest p{margin:5px 0 0;color:#986b80;font-size:13px}.interest .arrow{font-size:24px;color:var(--hot);text-align:right}
.gallery-section{padding-bottom:135px}.gallery-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:start}.shot{margin:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#4a1a34}.shot:nth-child(1){grid-column:1/span 5}.shot:nth-child(2){grid-column:7/span 6;margin-top:110px}.shot:nth-child(3){grid-column:2/span 4;margin-top:40px}.shot:nth-child(4){grid-column:7/span 5;margin-top:20px}.shot:nth-child(5){grid-column:1/span 6;margin-top:40px}.shot:nth-child(6){grid-column:8/span 5;margin-top:100px}.shot img{width:100%;height:440px;display:block;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),filter .6s;filter:saturate(.92)}.shot:nth-child(2n) img{height:370px}.shot:hover img{transform:scale(1.055);filter:saturate(1.15)}.shot figcaption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 2px;color:var(--pale);font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.13em}.shot figcaption b{font-size:17px;color:var(--pink)}.shot figcaption .download-link{display:inline-block;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--hot);border-radius:999px;color:var(--cream);font:10px "DM Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}.shot figcaption .download-link:hover{background:var(--hot);color:#fff}
.footer{background:var(--pink);color:var(--ink);padding:60px 0 30px}.footer-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:30px}.footer-title{font-size:clamp(40px,8vw,100px);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.09em;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase}.footer-title span{font-style:italic;font-weight:500}.footer-meta{font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace;line-height:2;letter-spacing:.12em;text-align:right;text-transform:uppercase}.footer-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid rgba(35,11,25,.25);padding-top:18px;margin-top:65px;font:9px 'DM Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(32px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes marquee{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(25px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}.hero-copy>*{animation:rise .8s both}.hero-copy>*:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.1s}.hero-copy>*:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.2s}.hero-copy>*:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.3s}.hero-art{animation:rise 1s .2s both}
@media(max-width:760px){.nav{height:auto;min-height:70px;align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:14px 0;gap:12px}.navlinks{gap:18px}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:55px 0 75px;gap:25px}.hero-art{min-height:440px}.hero-art img{height:390px;width:72%}.orbit{width:370px;height:370px}.hero-art:before{right:0}.section{padding:80px 0}.section-head{align-items:start;flex-direction:column}.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}.interests{padding:80px 0}.gallery-grid{gap:14px}.shot:nth-child(n){grid-column:span 6;margin-top:0}.shot img,.shot:nth-child(2n) img{height:280px}.footer-top{flex-direction:column}.footer-meta{text-align:left}.footer-bottom{gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap}}
@media(max-width:460px){h1{font-size:65px}.hero-art{min-height:360px}.hero-art img{height:315px}.orbit{width:300px;height:300px}.navlinks{font-size:9px;gap:14px}.interest{grid-template-columns:38px 1fr 22px;gap:12px}.shot:nth-child(n){grid-column:span 12}.shot img,.shot:nth-child(2n) img{height:auto;max-height:460px}.gallery-grid{gap:20px}.footer-bottom{font-size:8px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* Baby-pink refresh + uncropped desktop gallery */
body{background:#fff7fa;color:#542b40}
.topbar{background:rgba(255,247,250,.9);border-bottom:1px solid #f2cfdd}
.navlinks{color:#8e6175}.mono{color:#a96c85}.hero-desc{color:#8f6678}
.text-link{color:#a35e7b}.interest-list{border-color:#edc5d5}.interest{border-color:#edc5d5}
.interest p{color:#9b7284}.interest:hover{background:#ffedf4}
.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;align-items:stretch}
.shot,.shot:nth-child(n){grid-column:auto;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#ffeaf2;border:1px solid #f5cddd;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(174,102,132,.08)}
.shot img,.shot:nth-child(2n) img{width:100%;height:330px;object-fit:contain;display:block;background:#ffeaf2;padding:8px;cursor:zoom-in;filter:none;transition:transform .25s ease}
.shot:hover img{transform:scale(1.025);filter:none}
.shot figcaption{padding:11px 13px;color:#86566d;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;gap:8px}
.shot figcaption b{font-size:13px;color:#9d5575}
.shot figcaption a{background:#f7c7da;color:#6d3b52;border-radius:30px;padding:7px 11px;font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace;white-space:nowrap}
.footer{background:#f7c5d9;color:#542b40}
.footer-bottom{border-color:rgba(84,43,64,.2)}
@media(max-width:950px){.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:760px){.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.shot img,.shot:nth-child(2n) img{height:260px}.shot figcaption{padding:9px;font-size:9px}}
@media(max-width:460px){.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.shot img,.shot:nth-child(2n) img{height:360px;max-height:70vh}}
/* Minimal, keyboard- and touch-friendly image viewer */
.lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(55,25,42,.94);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:72px 76px 78px}
.lightbox.open{display:flex}.lightbox-stage{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.lightbox-image{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;transform:scale(1);transform-origin:center;transition:transform .12s ease;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.lb-toolbar{position:absolute;top:16px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,238,245,.96);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:40px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.lb-toolbar button,.lb-arrow{border:0;background:#f6c8da;color:#60334a;border-radius:50%;width:38px;height:38px;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}
.lb-toolbar button:hover,.lb-arrow:hover{background:#e99dbb}.lb-toolbar .lb-close{background:#e875a5;color:white;font-size:18px}
.lb-count{font:11px 'DM Mono',monospace;color:#75475d;min-width:48px;text-align:center}
.lb-arrow{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:46px;height:46px;font-size:24px}.lb-prev{left:16px}.lb-next{right:16px}
.lb-download{position:absolute;bottom:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#f7c7da;color:#60334a;text-decoration:none;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:40px;font:11px 'DM Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:.08em}
.lb-hint{position:absolute;bottom:25px;right:22px;color:#f8dce8;font:10px 'DM Mono',monospace;opacity:.8}
@media(max-width:600px){.lightbox{padding:75px 12px 78px}.lb-arrow{width:38px;height:38px}.lb-prev{left:5px}.lb-next{right:5px}.lb-hint{display:none}.lb-toolbar{gap:5px}.lb-toolbar button{width:34px;height:34px}}

/* FINAL VISIBILITY + DESKTOP FIT PATCH */
html, body { background:#fff4f8 !important; }
.gallery-grid { display:grid !important; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) !important; gap:22px !important; align-items:stretch !important; }
.gallery-grid .shot { grid-column:auto !important; margin:0 !important; padding:12px !important; background:#ffe5ef !important; border:1px solid #f5bfd3 !important; border-radius:18px !important; overflow:hidden !important; opacity:1 !important; transform:none !important; }
.gallery-grid .shot img { display:block !important; width:100% !important; height:440px !important; max-height:70vh !important; object-fit:contain !important; object-position:center !important; background:#fff8fb !important; opacity:1 !important; visibility:visible !important; cursor:zoom-in !important; }
.reveal, .reveal.in { opacity:1 !important; transform:none !important; }
.hero-art img { object-fit:contain !important; background:#fff8fb !important; }
.lightbox-image { width:auto !important; height:auto !important; max-width:100% !important; max-height:100% !important; object-fit:contain !important; }
@media (max-width:900px) { .gallery-grid { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)) !important; gap:14px !important; } .gallery-grid .shot img { height:380px !important; } }
@media (max-width:560px) { .gallery-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr !important; } .gallery-grid .shot img { height:auto !important; max-height:78vh !important; width:100% !important; } }


/* Gallery search */
.gallery-search-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:0 0 26px;max-width:680px}
.gallery-search{width:100%;border:1px solid rgba(30,24,27,.22);background:rgba(255,255,255,.72);border-radius:999px;padding:16px 22px;font:inherit;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink,#211b1e);outline:none;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.gallery-search:focus{border-color:#b86b91;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(184,107,145,.13)}
.gallery-search-count{font:11px/1.4 monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;color:rgba(30,24,27,.65)}
.shot.search-hidden{display:none!important}
.gallery-empty{display:none;padding:28px 4px;color:rgba(30,24,27,.7);font-size:14px}
.gallery-empty.visible{display:block}
@media(max-width:600px){.gallery-search-wrap{gap:8px;align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column}.gallery-search-count{padding-left:8px}}


.photo-caption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:11px 2px 3px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:rgba(30,24,27,.82)}
.photo-download{flex:0 0 auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(30,24,27,.3);border-radius:999px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.photo-download:hover{background:#241d21;color:#fff}
@media(max-width:480px){.photo-caption{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.photo-download{align-self:flex-start}}
</style></head><body>
<header class="topbar"><div class="shell nav"><a class="logo" href="#top">PUSSY <i>SISSY</i> WORLD</a><nav class="navlinks"><a href="#about">The world</a><a href="#interests">Interests</a><a href="#gallery">Gallery</a></nav><div class="nav-index">INDEPENDENT CREATIVE SPACE / 026</div></div></header>
<main id="top">
<section class="shell hero"><div class="hero-copy"><div class="mono kicker">A personal creative universe</div><h1>Pretty in<br/><span>motion.</span></h1><p class="hero-desc">A little world built around character-inspired looks, personal style, and the kind of cars that deserve their own spotlight.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="pill" href="#gallery">Enter the gallery <b>↗</b></a><a class="text-link" href="#about">Scroll to explore ↓</a></div></div><div class="hero-art"><div class="orbit"></div><img alt="Featured portrait" class="portrait" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
